Thanks, Marissa & Dev. Wed Feb 11 14:00 PST works for us — I'll have Ben and our infrastructure engineer attend.

Quick answers to your questions: 
- SOC 2: We need Type II for the most recent 12-month period. If you can provide the report and the list of control mappings (which controls cover which evidence), that would be ideal.
- Audit logs: Preferred delivery initially is an S3 bucket (read-only cross-account access) + sample log exports to review format. We also use Splunk but can do S3 to start.
- KMS: Our security policy prefers customer-managed keys (BYOK) for production workloads; for PoC/demo, Redwood-managed KMS is okay. We'll want details on how key rotation and HSM usage works.
- SSO: We use Okta; SCIM provisioning would be preferred for user lifecycle.

I'll upload our security questionnaire and procurement notes; Sarah will follow up separately on PO timing.

I'll send a calendar invite for Wed 14:00 PST.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Security Lead | Acme Corp
alice.chen@acmecorp.com
